title: Messaging — Mux Admin Revoke All — payload
description: An administrator advances a member DID's epoch at the mediator, voiding every grant on it at once and ending its session attaches, without the member's signature. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

did.description: The member DID whose epoch is advanced.

epoch.description: The epoch being voided: the member DID's current one, as messaging/mux/admin-list with `member` reports it.

Response.title: Messaging — Mux Admin Revoke All — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a messaging/mux/admin-revoke-all request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/mux/admin-revoke-all/0.1#response.

epoch.description: The member DID's epoch now in force; a new grant must carry it.

epochAdvanced.description: False when the epoch named in the request had already been voided, so nothing changed.

revokedGrants.description: How many grants that were active this request moved to `epochRevoked`.
